items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring (Grade 1 previously); expected to miss another game.
items.implication: Sit Collins; elevated targets for Dalton Schultz and remaining WRs.
items.opportunity: Schultz high target share continuation; Hutchinson/others.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected knee surgery (meniscus/MCL/PCL, ACL intact) that ends his 2026 season; full recovery expected. Jameis Winston set to start.
items.why: Surgery confirmed by sources and coach; ACL intact but season over.
items.implication: Giants offense shifts to Winston; Nabers and pass-catchers face QB downgrade short-term.
items.opportunity: Winston streaming upside; Giants skill players volume may hold or shift.

items.text: After good MRI results on stinger/shoulder, Saquon Barkley is on the practice field suited up and expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: MRI clean; present and expecting to play MNF.
items.implication: Start Barkley with confidence; reverse prior handcuff elevation.
items.opportunity: Full workload likely with extra rest day.

items.text: McVay on Puka Nacua (hip/groin): 'We’ll see … He’s not making great progress.' Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua (42% target rate); 8-195-2 in last miss.
items.why: No great progress per coach; DNP Wed; cautious approach, not long-term.
items.implication: Adams massive upgrade/WR1 ceiling; Ferguson/Mumpfield also rise.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate and prior big games without Nacua; route tree expansion.

items.text: Bears Tyson Bagent officially DNP first practice (concussion protocol); all signs point to Case Keenum starting with Caleb Williams likely out hamstring.
items.implication: Bears offense downgrade; fade pass catchers somewhat vs Eagles.
items.opportunity: Limited; stream defense or avoid Bears skill.

items.text: No Zay Flowers for second straight practice (hamstring); looking like Ravens without him again vs Cowboys in Brazil.
items.why: Consecutive absences after Week 2 miss; aggravated prior issue.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; Bateman and others elevated.

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded GB backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London/Kyle Pitts? Jayden Reed absence more 2-TE Packers? Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.why: Role questions and health for key TNF players; Reed OUT confirmed.
items.implication: Monitor Lloyd snap share; London/Pitts boost with Penix; Watson volume up.
items.opportunity: London/Pitts route/target spike; Watson red-zone; Johnson over Lloyd.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks placed on IR after core muscle surgery; out at least 4-6+ weeks, expected back later.
items.implication: Chuba Hubbard locked as lead back; AJ Dillon backup stash.

items.text: Week 3 injury waiver beneficiaries: Flowers/Lane=Bateman; Dobbins/Harvey=Jonah Coleman; Barkley=Bigsby/Shipley; Goedert=Wicks; Dart=Winston; Brooks=AJ Dillon stash; Pierce=Keenan Allen; etc.
items.implication: Priority adds for injured stars' backups.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead if Dobbins/Harvey out; Bateman with Flowers; Hubbard locked.
items.conflict: Barkley now practicing reverses Bigsby somewhat.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak Dallas run D; prop highest on slate.
items.opportunity: Volume and yards upside in Brazil game.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: High volume/aDOT profile vs soft secondary allowing big YPR.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
items.why: Workhorse usage meets soft run D.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Loves Brock Purdy vs ARI: 49ers implied 28 (3rd-high); ARI secondary lost top CB to IR, bottom-8 YPA/TD rate allowed.
